title: Chapter 300: Assemble A Strong Army To Attack The Main City
content:
Chapter 300: Assemble A Strong Army To Attack The Main City

When the desert races on the desert battlefield gathered their troops, the war between the Zerg army and the alien army on the public battlefield of the southern theater also entered a turning point.

The aliens continued to send hundreds of millions of elite troops to Jiujiuliu City, but ultimately could not change the situation of being suppressed and consumed by the Zerg army in the city.

The aliens drew a large number of elite troops on the public battlefield, which affected the combat forces in other places, allowing the local camp to seize the opportunity and start a counterattack.

This caused a major change in the situation on the public battlefield of the entire southern theater.

The bears, wolves and eagles seized this rare opportunity for the status of the great tribes that countless races fought for, no longer reserved their strength, and began to counterattack with all their strength.

The three powerful tribes that could originally confront the aliens took advantage of the situation at this time, and the situation of the aliens became very bad.

The alien army on the public battlefield of the southern theater was defeated under the comprehensive attack of the various ethnic armies of the local camp headed by the three powerful tribes.

The Queen of Zerg obtained this information through the Sky Silkworm Knights walking in the main cities of the public war zone in the southern war zone, and then reported it to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing came to the battlefield of the Tianwai people's Jiujiuliu City and saw that the Tianwai people's space transmission channel was basically idle. The Tianwai people could no longer draw elite troops from other areas to reinforce.

"The Tianwai people are going to give up this battlefield!"

"Let's end this war as soon as possible and move the battlefield to their main city!"

Wu Qing immediately issued the latest combat order to the Queen of Zerg.

The Zerg has initially completed the goal of containing a large number of Tianwai people's troops, and the battlefield here is no longer necessary.

The Zerg army, which was originally fighting and resting on the battlefield, immediately took action and officially launched a siege.

With the Zerg main combat force as the core, the Zerg army advanced step by step towards the Tianwai people's Jiujiuliu City.

The ultra-long-range attacks of the five-star Zerg air guards and Zerg destroyers opened fire at full speed to attack the long-range attack arms behind the Tianwai army.

Ten six-star Zerg Scorpions and ten six-star Zerg Mammoths, which had not taken action for a long time, became the vanguard again. The Zerg Scorpions released the plague, and the Zerg Mammoths were responsible for opening the way and attacking.

This time, it was no longer the Zerg Zerglings that charged behind them, but the main Zerg combat units. The Zerg Hydralisks rushed to the front. They were stronger and more efficient in killing the enemy.

Zerg Type II Toxic Ray Scorpions, Zerg Cockroaches, Zerg Stealth Spiders and Zerg Destroyers followed behind, and Zerg Devourers, Zerg Sky Guardians, Zerg Dragons and Zerg Queens advanced from the air.

Because the alien human army still had a lot of troops, in order to speed up the speed of annihilation, Wu Qing selected 10,000 Zerg Dragons and evolved them into five-star Zerg Devourers.

With 20,000 five-star Zerg Devourers opening the way, the Zerg army's efficiency in killing the enemy would be greatly improved, whether it was against the air or the ground.

The special spore infection ability of the Zerg Devourer attack is really useful on the battlefield, which is equivalent to a miniature plague.

Although the alien army now has a large number of troops, the alien army is rarely seen, and they are basically the armies of the alien races.

The reason why the aliens insist on not withdrawing is not only because of face, but also because they want to consume some of the Zerg's troops.

Unfortunately, they don't know that the Zerg's troops are getting stronger and stronger.

Faced with the gradual advancement of the Zerg's main combat arms, the alien army can't resist at all.

So, the aliens sent all the troops of Jiujiuli City out, attacking the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions outside the city.

After the system resources are sufficient, the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions have increased a lot. They work together with the Zerg puppies, and the gap in combat power with the army of the alien races is not large, enough to fight.

But it was only enough for a fight. The troops sent by the aliens were all elite troops. In the battle with them, the casualties of the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions were very heavy.

The Zerg air force was divided into two, starting from the left and right directions of the Zerg main combat arms, and circled the city to support the battle of the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

With the support of the Zerg air force, with the powerful firepower support of the five-star Zerg Devourer and the five-star Zerg Air Guard, the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions can destroy the attacking forces of the aliens with little loss.

This Zerg army's siege lasted a whole day, and countless alien troops disappeared in this battle.

The main Zerg participating forces, the Zerg Puppies and the three-type Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions also suffered heavy losses.

The space transmission channel of the alien race in the 996 city did not explode this time, but was dismantled by the alien race. The important parts were taken away by a team of alien race strongmen who suddenly appeared.

Wu Qing didn't care and didn't attack those strongmen. Provoking a battle between strongmen on a public battlefield would have a huge impact and would involve many races. It was not just the matter of the Zerg.

Wu Qing had no intention of taking the initiative to cause trouble for the time being. Unless it was absolutely necessary, the Zerg would not take the initiative to attack the strongmen of the alien race.

Now that the Zerg has opened up a new desert battlefield, there is no need to provoke trouble on the public battlefield, so as not to affect the Zerg's status as a major race.

The Zerg army fully occupied the 996 city of the alien race. This siege war that lasted for a long time finally ended.

But the war between the Zerg and the Terrans is far from over.

The Zerg puppies cooperated with the Zerg host to dig through the entire city of Nine-Nine-Six and eliminate all safety hazards.

The scale of this battle between the Zerg and the Outer Humans was extremely rare. The amount of loot piled up on the battlefields in and around the Nine-Nine-Sixth City was beyond counting.

The Tianwai Human Race and its affiliated races are extremely dependent on sophisticated equipment. When the Zerg fight against them, just the spoils are a huge gain.

Enemies killed by the Zerg army will turn into light and disappear. When fighting against a race like the Demon Clan, which relies entirely on its own combat power, it will basically not get much loot. The Demon Clan has a lot of good materials. Unfortunately, for the sake of system resources, the Zerg Clan can only Choose not to.

This time the Zerg harvested too much loot. Wu Qing asked the Queen of the Zerg to contact the Goblins and ask the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to handle the loot.

Leave professional matters to professionals.

It can be regarded as making good friends with the goblins.

Of course Wu Qing would not forget to let the Insect Queen continue to trade Zerg energy coins with the Goblins.

The Goblins are already a super-rich clan in the local camp. With the support of the Zerg energy coins, the Goblins may be able to move forward in their ranking among the super-rich clans.

If the Zerg tribe wants to gain the status of a major clan, it also needs the help of the goblin tribe in the middle. If Wu Qing can make good friends, he should try his best to make good friends with them.

…

In the current battle situation on the public battlefield in the southern theater, the local camp has the upper hand. To continue to maintain this state, the Zerg attack cannot stop.

Wu Qing is preparing to lead an army straight to the main city of the Tianwai Human Race in this area, and completely defeat the Tianwai Human Race on this public battlefield.

The main city of the Tianwai human race is far away from the first branch base of the Zerg tribe, so it is not convenient for the support of the Zerg tribe's rear troops.

Wu Qing did not want to build a second Zerg sub-base on this public battlefield, so he could only make some adjustments to the strength of the Zerg army that went out.

Now that the Zerg has unlocked all arms, the troop allocation of the Zerg's main combat arms must be adjusted appropriately.

The first to increase the strength was the Zerg flying dragon, the basic unit of the air force. Wu Qing added another 500,000 one-star Zerg flying dragons, increasing the number of Zerg flying dragons on the public battlefield to one million.

Zerg flying dragons fight with the Zerg Devourer and Zerg Aerial Guardian, acting as air and ground clearers. When necessary, they can evolve and upgrade into Zerg Devourer and Zerg Aerial Guardian.

Wu Qing increased the strength of the ultimate units, the five-star Zerg Devourer and the five-star Zerg Air Guard, by 10,000 each, reaching 30,000 and 20,000 respectively.

In order to deal with the sudden attack by the powerful humans from outside the world, Wu Qing increased the number of six-star Zerg Scorpions and Six-star Zerg Monmasses to fifty, and also added ten six-star Zerg Queens.

These six-star troops all have the strength to fight against the seven-star powerhouses of the Tianwai Human Race. They can deal with the seven-star powerhouses of the Tianwai Human Race without the Queen of Insects taking action.

With such a force configuration of the air force, the combat power is basically sufficient, but if it is not enough, it can continue to improve its strength and use quality to make up for the lack of quantity.

The Zerg's main ground combat units are still Zerg destroyers and air defense units, which assist in defending against ground attacks. The Zerg stealth spiders have the best effect, so Wu Qing focused on strengthening these three aspects of troops this time.

Add 350,000 one-star Zerg Destroyers, raising the total strength of Zerg Destroyers to 500,000.

An additional 700,000 one-star type II Zerg poisonous ray scorpions were added, raising the total strength of type II Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to one million.

One million Zerg Hydralisks and one million Type 2 Zerg Venomous Ray Scorpions form the air defense force that protects the Zerg ground battle units.

Add 200,000 one-star Zerg Stealth Spiders, raising the total strength of Zerg Stealth Spiders to 500,000.

One million Zerg Hydralisks, one million Type 2 Zerg Venomous Ray Scorpions, 500,000 Zerg Destroyers, 500,000 Zerg Cockroaches, and 500,000 Zerg Stealth Spiders, these 3.5 million Zerg main battle units are composed of The Zerg ground main battle force.

One million Zerg flying dragons, 30,000 Zerg Devourers, and 20,000 Zerg aerial guards. These 1.05 million Zerg main combat units make up the Zerg air force.

Coupled with other special arms, the Zerg army has nearly five million troops, composed entirely of the Zerg main combat arms.

This Zerg main battle force, led by 50 million Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, set off towards the main city of the outer human race.

Subsequent reinforcements of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions will continue to follow.

The Zerg puppies that originally entered the territory of the local camp also changed their direction and rushed into the territory of the outer human race.
